ko.title: 2027년 더 많이 저축하기: 은퇴 계좌 한도 조정이 401(k) 및 IRA에 의미하는 바

segments.src: Every fall, the Internal Revenue Service publishes cost-of-living adjustments for the coming year, including the contribution limits for workplace retirement plans and individual retirement accounts.
segments.tr: 매년 가을, 미국 국세청(IRS)은 직장 은퇴 플랜 및 개인 은퇴 계좌(IRA)의 납입 한도를 포함하여 내년도 생활비 조정치(COLA)를 발표합니다.

segments.src: Because many of these limits are indexed to inflation, they tend to creep up over time.
segments.tr: 이러한 한도의 상당수가 인플레이션에 연동되어 있기 때문에 시간이 지남에 따라 조금씩 오르는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: This guide explains how the limits work, which numbers to watch, and who is actually in a position to use the extra room.
segments.tr: 이 가이드에서는 한도가 어떻게 작동하는지, 어떤 숫자를 주시해야 하는지, 그리고 실제로 이 추가 한도를 활용할 수 있는 위치에 있는 사람이 누구인지 설명합니다.

segments.src: *Note: This article is general information, not tax, legal or investment advice.
segments.tr: *참고: 이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공 목적이며 세무, 법률 또는 투자 자문이 아닙니다.

segments.src: The 2027 figures should be confirmed against the IRS announcement.
segments.tr: 2027년 수치는 IRS 공시를 통해 확인해야 합니다.

segments.src: The figures below for 2026 are the most recent published baseline, so use them as a reference point.*
segments.tr: 아래의 2026년 수치는 가장 최근에 발표된 기준점이므로 참고 자료로 사용하세요.*

segments.src: ## How the annual adjustments work
segments.tr: ## 연례 한도 조정 작동 방식

segments.src: Congress sets the formulas, and the IRS applies inflation data to them.
segments.tr: 의회가 공식을 정하면 IRS가 여기에 인플레이션 데이터를 적용합니다.

segments.src: A few key points:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 주요 사항은 다음과 같습니다.

segments.src: - **Indexing is not automatic for every limit.** Many caps rise only once inflation pushes the calculation past a rounding threshold. The 401(k) deferral limit is adjusted in $500 steps, while the IRA limit moves in $500 steps as well, so a modest rise in prices may produce no change at all in some years.
segments.tr: - **모든 한도가 자동으로 연동되어 인상되는 것은 아닙니다.** 많은 한도 상한은 인플레이션으로 인해 계산 금액이 반올림 기준값을 초과할 때만 인상됩니다. 401(k) 급여 공제 한도는 $500 단위로 조정되며, IRA 한도 역시 $500 단위로 이동하므로 완만한 물가 상승이 있는 해에는 아무런 변화가 없을 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Announcements usually arrive in October or November.** Employers and payroll providers then update their systems, often in time for the new year.
segments.tr: - **발표는 보통 10월이나 11월에 이루어집니다.** 이후 고용주와 급여 관리업체가 새해에 맞춰 시스템을 업데이트합니다.

segments.src: - **Limits apply per person, not per account.** The 401(k) employee deferral limit is shared across all of your workplace plans of the same type. The IRA limit is shared across all of your traditional and Roth IRAs.
segments.tr: - **한도는 계좌별이 아니라 1인당 적용됩니다.** 401(k) 종업원 급여 공제 한도는 동일한 유형의 모든 직장 플랜 전체에 합산되어 적용됩니다. IRA 한도는 모든 저축형(Traditional) 및 Roth IRA 합산으로 적용됩니다.

segments.src: ## Catch-up contributions: what to know
segments.tr: ## 캐치업 추가 납입: 알아두어야 할 사항

segments.src: Catch-up contributions let older savers put away more than the standard limit.
segments.tr: 캐치업(Catch-up) 추가 납입은 고령 저축자가 일반 한도보다 더 많은 금액을 저축할 수 있게 해줍니다.

segments.src: Two features deserve attention.
segments.tr: 두 가지 특징에 주목할 필요가 있습니다.

segments.src: **The ages 60 to 63 window.** Under the SECURE 2.0 Act, workers who turn 60, 61, 62 or 63 during the year may be eligible for a higher catch-up amount than the standard age-50 catch-up.
segments.tr: **60세~63세 구간.** SECURE 2.0 법안에 따라, 해당 연도 중 60세, 61세, 62세 또는 63세가 되는 근로자는 일반적인 50세 이상 캐치업보다 더 높은 금액의 캐치업 자격을 얻을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: It is available only if your plan has adopted it, so check with your plan administrator.
segments.tr: 단, 귀하의 플랜이 이 규정을 채택한 경우에만 이용 가능하므로 플랜 관리자에게 확인하세요.

segments.src: **Roth treatment for higher earners.** Beginning in 2026, workers whose prior-year wages from the employer sponsoring the plan exceeded a set threshold (indexed from $145,000, and $150,000 for 2026) must make their catch-up contributions on a Roth, or after-tax, basis.
segments.tr: **고소득자에 대한 Roth 적용.** 2026년부터, 플랜을 후원하는 고용주로부터 받은 전년도 임금이 일정 기준(인플레이션 연동 $145,000부터 시작, 2026년 기준 $150,000)을 초과하는 근로자는 캐치업 추가 납입을 반드시 Roth(세후) 방식으로 진행해야 합니다.

segments.src: That means no upfront tax deduction, but qualified withdrawals can be tax-free later.
segments.tr: 이는 즉각적인 소득공제 혜택은 없지만, 나중에 요건을 갖춘 인출 시 비과세 혜택을 받을 수 있음을 의미합니다.

segments.src: If your plan does not offer a Roth option, affected workers may not be able to make catch-up contributions at all, so it is worth asking.
segments.tr: 귀하의 플랜이 Roth 옵션을 제공하지 않는 경우 해당 근로자는 캐치업 납입을 전혀 하지 못할 수도 있으므로 미리 확인해 볼 가치가 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Income thresholds: who can use the extra room
segments.tr: ## 소득 기준선: 누가 추가 한도를 활용할 수 있는가

segments.src: Raising a cap does not help if your income or your plan features keep you from using it.
segments.tr: 한도를 올리더라도 소득이나 플랜의 조건 때문에 이용할 수 없다면 도움이 되지 않습니다.

segments.src: Several thresholds matter.
segments.tr: 몇 가지 중요한 소득 기준선이 있습니다.

segments.src: **Traditional IRA deductions.** If you or your spouse is covered by a workplace plan, the deduction for traditional IRA contributions phases out at certain income levels.
segments.tr: **일반 Traditional IRA 공제.** 본인이나 배우자가 직장 은퇴 플랜에 가입되어 있는 경우, Traditional IRA 납입금에 대한 소득공제 혜택은 일정 소득 수준에서 단계적으로 축소됩니다.

segments.src: For 2026, the range for single filers covered by a workplace plan is $81,000 to $91,000 of modified adjusted gross income.
segments.tr: 2026년 기준, 직장 플랜에 가입된 단독 신고자의 조정 수정 가계 소득(MAGI) 구간은 $81,000 ~ $91,000입니다.

segments.src: For married couples filing jointly where the contributing spouse is covered, it is $129,000 to $149,000.
segments.tr: 납입하는 배우자가 직장 플랜에 가입되어 있는 부부 공동 신고의 경우 $129,000 ~ $149,000입니다.

segments.src: **Roth IRA eligibility.** The ability to contribute directly to a Roth IRA phases out at higher incomes.
segments.tr: **Roth IRA 가입 자격.** Roth IRA에 직접 납입할 수 있는 자격은 고소득 구간에서 단계적으로 축소됩니다.

segments.src: For 2026, the range is $153,000 to $168,000 for single filers and $242,000 to $252,000 for married couples filing jointly.
**The Saver's Credit.** Lower- and moderate-income workers may qualify for a tax credit of up to 50% of a limited amount of retirement contributions.
segments.tr: **저축자 세액공제(Saver's Credit).** 저소득 및 중저소득 근로자는 은퇴 계좌 납입금의 일정 금액에 대해 최대 50%의 세액공제 자격을 얻을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Income limits rise each year with inflation, so a higher threshold can bring new households into eligibility.
segments.tr: 소득 한도는 매년 인플레이션에 맞춰 상향되므로, 기준선이 높아지면 새로운 가구가 공제 자격을 얻을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: When these income ranges move up, more households can deduct IRA contributions or contribute to a Roth IRA, even if the headline dollar limit stays the same.
segments.tr: 이러한 소득 구간이 상향 조정되면, 표면적인 달러 한도가 동일하게 유지되더라도 더 많은 가구가 IRA 납입금을 소득공제 받거나 Roth IRA에 납입할 수 있게 됩니다.

segments.src: ## Who can realistically use the higher limits
segments.tr: ## 현실적으로 누가 더 높은 한도를 활용할 수 있는가

segments.src: The honest answer is that most workers do not reach the maximums.
segments.tr: 솔직한 답은 대부분의 근로자가 최대로 납입하지 못한다는 것입니다.

segments.src: Industry data on plan participants consistently shows that only a small share of savers contribute the full amount allowed.
segments.tr: 플랜 가입자에 대한 업계 데이터에 따르면 허용된 전체 금액을 납입하는 저축자의 비율은 소수에 불과합니다.

segments.src: Higher limits are most relevant to:
segments.tr: 더 높은 한도가 가장 유의미한 대상은 다음과 같습니다.

segments.src: - **High earners** who already max out their accounts and want more tax-advantaged space.
segments.tr: - 이미 계좌를 한도까지 채우고 있으며 절세 혜택이 있는 추가 공간을 원하는 **고소득자**.

segments.src: - **Workers over 50**, who tend to have more disposable income and a shorter runway to retirement.
segments.tr: - 가처분 소득이 더 많고 은퇴까지 남은 기간이 짧은 **50세 이상 근로자**.

segments.src: - **Households with a plan that allows extra features**, such as after-tax contributions or in-plan Roth conversions.
segments.tr: - 세후 납입이나 플랜 내 Roth 전환과 같은 추가 기능을 허용하는 플랜을 가진 **가구**.

segments.src: For everyone else, the more useful step may be raising a contribution rate by one or two percentage points rather than aiming for the cap.
segments.tr: 그 외의 모든 사람에게는 한도를 목표로 삼는 것보다 납입 비율을 1~2%포인트 올리는 것이 더 유용한 조치가 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Practical steps before January
segments.tr: ## 1월이 오기 전 실천할 단계

segments.src: 1. **Check your current contribution rate.** Compare what you contribute to the limit and see how much room you have.
segments.tr: 1. **현재 납입 비율을 확인하세요.** 현재 납입 금액을 한도와 비교하여 남아있는 한도가 얼마인지 확인하세요.

segments.src: 2. **Capture the employer match first.** Free matching dollars generally come before any other savings goal.
segments.tr: 2. **고용주 매칭 혜택부터 확보하세요.** 무상으로 제공되는 매칭 지원금은 일반적으로 다른 어떤 저축 목표보다 우선시됩니다.

segments.src: 3. **Ask about plan features.** Find out whether your plan offers Roth contributions, catch-up contributions, and the ages 60 to 63 option.
segments.tr: 3. **플랜 기능을 문의하세요.** 귀하의 플랜이 Roth 납입, 캐치업 추가 납입, 60세~63세 옵션을 제공하는지 확인하세요.

segments.src: 4. **Plan for the Roth catch-up rule** if your wages are near the threshold.
segments.tr: 4. 임금이 기준선에 가깝다면 **Roth 캐치업 규정에 대비하세요**.

segments.src: 5. **Set up automatic increases.** Many plans can raise your contribution rate annually, which makes use of new room without extra effort.
segments.tr: 5. **자동 인상을 설정하세요.** 많은 플랜이 매년 납입 비율을 자동으로 올려주므로 별도의 노력 없이도 새로 늘어난 한도를 활용할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 6. **Review your tax situation.** A tax professional can help you decide between pre-tax and Roth contributions based on your current and expected future bracket.
segments.tr: 6. **세금 상황을 검토하세요.** 세무 전문가의 도움을 받아 현재 및 예상되는 미래 소득세율 구간을 바탕으로 사전 과세 공제(Pre-tax) 방식과 Roth 방식 중 선택할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 핵심 요약

segments.src: The yearly adjustment is a small but useful opportunity.
segments.tr: 매년 이루어지는 한도 조정은 작지만 유용한 기회입니다.

segments.src: Whether the new limits matter to you depends less on the headline numbers and more on your income, your age, and what your plan allows.
segments.tr: 새로운 한도가 귀하에게 중요한지 여부는 발표된 숫자 자체보다는 귀하의 소득, 연령, 그리고 플랜이 허용하는 조건에 더 크게 좌우됩니다.

segments.src: Once the IRS publishes the official 2027 figures, compare them with your current contribution settings and adjust early in the year, when you have the most time to spread contributions across paychecks.
segments.tr: IRS가 공식 2027년 수치를 발표하면, 이를 현재 납입 설정과 비교해보고 급여 수령 시마다 납입금을 분산할 시간이 가장 충분한 연초에 빠르게 조정하세요.

segments.src: ## How the annual adjustments work

segments.src: Congress sets the formulas, and the IRS applies inflation data to them.

segments.src: A few key points:
segments.tr: 几个关键点：

segments.src: - **Indexing is not automatic for every limit.** Many caps rise only once inflation pushes the calculation past a rounding threshold. The 401(k) deferral limit is adjusted in $500 steps, while the IRA limit moves in $500 steps as well, so a modest rise in prices may produce no change at all in some years.
segments.tr: - **并非每个限额的指数化都是自动的。** 许多上限只有在通胀推动计算结果超过舍入阈值时才会提高。401(k) 延期缴款限额以 $500 为单位进行调整，IRA 限额也以 $500 为单位变动，因此物价的小幅上涨在某些年份可能根本不会导致任何变化。

segments.src: - **Announcements usually arrive in October or November.** Employers and payroll providers then update their systems, often in time for the new year.
segments.tr: - **公告通常在 10 月或 11 月发布。** 雇主和薪资服务提供商随后会更新其系统，通常能赶在新的一年到来之前完成。

segments.src: - **Limits apply per person, not per account.** The 401(k) employee deferral limit is shared across all of your workplace plans of the same type. The IRA limit is shared across all of your traditional and Roth IRAs.
segments.tr: - **限额按人计算，而非按账户计算。** 401(k) 员工延期缴款限额在您所有同类型的工作场所计划中共享。IRA 限额在您所有的传统 IRA 和 Roth IRA 中共享。

segments.tr: 如果 2027 年的调整遵循通常的模式，预计其中一些项目的限额会有小幅增加，而其他项目则保持不变。

segments.src: ## Catch-up contributions: what to know
segments.tr: ## 补缴贡献：需要了解的内容

segments.src: Catch-up contributions let older savers put away more than the standard limit.
segments.tr: 补缴贡献允许年长的储蓄者存入超过标准限额的资金。

segments.src: Two features deserve attention.
segments.tr: 有两个特点值得注意。

segments.src: **The ages 60 to 63 window.** Under the SECURE 2.0 Act, workers who turn 60, 61, 62 or 63 during the year may be eligible for a higher catch-up amount than the standard age-50 catch-up.
segments.tr: **60 至 63 岁的窗口期。** 根据《SECURE 2.0 法案》，在当年年满 60、61、62 或 63 岁的员工可能有资格获得比标准 50 岁补缴额更高的补缴金额。

segments.src: It is available only if your plan has adopted it, so check with your plan administrator.
segments.tr: 这仅在您的计划已采纳该规定时才适用，因此请咨询您的计划管理员。

segments.src: **Roth treatment for higher earners.** Beginning in 2026, workers whose prior-year wages from the employer sponsoring the plan exceeded a set threshold (indexed from $145,000, and $150,000 for 2026) must make their catch-up contributions on a Roth, or after-tax, basis.
segments.tr: **针对高收入者的 Roth 处理方式。** 从 2026 年开始，如果员工上一年度从资助该计划的雇主处获得的工资超过了设定的阈值（从 $145,000 指数化而来，2026 年为 $150,000），则必须以 Roth 或税后方式进行补缴贡献。

segments.src: That means no upfront tax deduction, but qualified withdrawals can be tax-free later.
segments.tr: 这意味着没有预先的税收减免，但符合条件的提款在以后可以是免税的。

segments.src: If your plan does not offer a Roth option, affected workers may not be able to make catch-up contributions at all, so it is worth asking.
segments.tr: 如果您的计划不提供 Roth 选项，受影响的员工可能根本无法进行补缴贡献，因此值得询问。

segments.src: ## Income thresholds: who can use the extra room
segments.tr: ## 收入阈值：谁可以使用额外的空间

segments.src: Raising a cap does not help if your income or your plan features keep you from using it.
segments.tr: 如果您的收入或计划功能限制了您使用上限，那么提高上限对您没有帮助。

segments.src: Several thresholds matter.
segments.tr: 有几个阈值很重要。

segments.src: **Traditional IRA deductions.** If you or your spouse is covered by a workplace plan, the deduction for traditional IRA contributions phases out at certain income levels.
segments.tr: **传统 IRA 扣除额。** 如果您或您的配偶参加了工作场所计划，传统 IRA 缴款的扣除额会在特定的收入水平下逐步取消。

segments.src: For 2026, the range for single filers covered by a workplace plan is $81,000 to $91,000 of modified adjusted gross income.
segments.tr: 对于 2026 年，参加工作场所计划的单身申报者的调整后总收入 (MAGI) 范围为 $81,000 至 $91,000。

segments.src: For married couples filing jointly where the contributing spouse is covered, it is $129,000 to $149,000.
segments.tr: 对于联合申报的已婚夫妇，如果缴款配偶已参加计划，则该范围为 $129,000 至 $149,000。

segments.src: **Roth IRA eligibility.** The ability to contribute directly to a Roth IRA phases out at higher incomes.
segments.tr: **Roth IRA 资格。** 直接向 Roth IRA 缴款的能力会在较高收入时逐步取消。

segments.src: For 2026, the range is $153,000 to $168,000 for single filers and $242,000 to $252,000 for married couples filing jointly.
**The Saver's Credit.** Lower- and moderate-income workers may qualify for a tax credit of up to 50% of a limited amount of retirement contributions.
segments.tr: **储蓄者抵免 (Saver's Credit)。** 低收入和中等收入的员工可能有资格获得最高相当于有限退休缴款额 50% 的税收抵免。

segments.src: Income limits rise each year with inflation, so a higher threshold can bring new households into eligibility.
segments.tr: 收入限额每年随通胀上升，因此更高的阈值可以将新的家庭纳入资格范围。

segments.src: When these income ranges move up, more households can deduct IRA contributions or contribute to a Roth IRA, even if the headline dollar limit stays the same.
segments.tr: 当这些收入范围上调时，即使名义上的美元限额保持不变，更多的家庭也可以扣除 IRA 缴款或向 Roth IRA 缴款。

segments.src: ## Who can realistically use the higher limits
segments.tr: ## 谁能真正利用更高的限额

segments.src: The honest answer is that most workers do not reach the maximums.
segments.tr: 诚实的回答是，大多数员工达不到最高限额。

segments.src: Industry data on plan participants consistently shows that only a small share of savers contribute the full amount allowed.
segments.tr: 关于计划参与者的行业数据一致显示，只有一小部分储蓄者存入了允许的全部金额。

segments.src: Higher limits are most relevant to:
segments.tr: 更高的限额最适用于：

segments.src: - **High earners** who already max out their accounts and want more tax-advantaged space.
segments.tr: - **高收入者**，他们已经存满了账户，并希望获得更多的税收优惠空间。

segments.src: - **Workers over 50**, who tend to have more disposable income and a shorter runway to retirement.
segments.tr: - **50 岁以上的员工**，他们往往有更多的可支配收入，且距离退休的时间更短。

segments.src: - **Households with a plan that allows extra features**, such as after-tax contributions or in-plan Roth conversions.
segments.tr: - **拥有允许额外功能计划的家庭**，例如税后缴款或计划内 Roth 转换。

segments.src: For everyone else, the more useful step may be raising a contribution rate by one or two percentage points rather than aiming for the cap.
segments.tr: 对于其他人来说，更有用的步骤可能是将缴款率提高一两个百分点，而不是以达到上限为目标。

segments.src: ## Practical steps before January
segments.tr: ## 1 月份之前的实际步骤

segments.src: 1. **Check your current contribution rate.** Compare what you contribute to the limit and see how much room you have.
segments.tr: 1. **检查您当前的缴款率。** 将您的缴款额与限额进行比较，看看您还有多少空间。

segments.src: 2. **Capture the employer match first.** Free matching dollars generally come before any other savings goal.
segments.tr: 2. **首先获得雇主匹配。** 免费的匹配资金通常优先于任何其他储蓄目标。

segments.src: 3. **Ask about plan features.** Find out whether your plan offers Roth contributions, catch-up contributions, and the ages 60 to 63 option.
segments.tr: 3. **询问计划功能。** 了解您的计划是否提供 Roth 缴款、补缴贡献以及 60 至 63 岁的选项。

segments.src: 4. **Plan for the Roth catch-up rule** if your wages are near the threshold.
segments.tr: 4. **如果您的工资接近阈值，请为 Roth 补缴规则做好计划。**

segments.src: 5. **Set up automatic increases.** Many plans can raise your contribution rate annually, which makes use of new room without extra effort.
segments.tr: 5. **设置自动增加。** 许多计划可以每年提高您的缴款率，这无需额外努力即可利用新的空间。

segments.src: 6. **Review your tax situation.** A tax professional can help you decide between pre-tax and Roth contributions based on your current and expected future bracket.
segments.tr: 6. **审查您的税务状况。** 税务专业人士可以根据您当前和预期的未来税率等级，帮助您决定选择税前缴款还是 Roth 缴款。

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: The yearly adjustment is a small but useful opportunity.
segments.tr: 年度调整是一个小而有用的机会。

segments.src: Whether the new limits matter to you depends less on the headline numbers and more on your income, your age, and what your plan allows.
segments.tr: 新的限额对您是否重要，取决于您的收入、年龄以及您的计划允许的内容，而不是名义上的数字。

segments.src: Once the IRS publishes the official 2027 figures, compare them with your current contribution settings and adjust early in the year, when you have the most time to spread contributions across paychecks.
segments.tr: 一旦 IRS 发布了 2027 年的官方数据，请将其与您当前的缴款设置进行比较，并在年初尽早进行调整，因为那时您有最多的时间将缴款分摊到各个工资单中。

hi.title: 2027 के लिए अधिक बचत: सेवानिवृत्ति सीमा समायोजन का आपके 401(k) और IRA के लिए क्या अर्थ हो सकता है

segments.src: Every fall, the Internal Revenue Service publishes cost-of-living adjustments for the coming year, including the contribution limits for workplace retirement plans and individual retirement accounts.
segments.tr: हर पतझड़ में, इंटरनल रेवेन्यू सर्विस (IRS) आने वाले वर्ष के लिए जीवन-यापन लागत समायोजन (cost-of-living adjustments) प्रकाशित करती है, जिसमें कार्यस्थल सेवानिवृत्ति योजनाओं और व्यक्तिगत सेवानिवृत्ति खातों (IRA) के लिए योगदान सीमाएं शामिल हैं।

segments.src: Because many of these limits are indexed to inflation, they tend to creep up over time.
segments.tr: चूंकि इनमें से कई सीमाएं मुद्रास्फीति से जुड़ी होती हैं, इसलिए वे समय के साथ धीरे-धीरे बढ़ती रहती हैं।

segments.src: This guide explains how the limits work, which numbers to watch, and who is actually in a position to use the extra room.
segments.tr: यह गाइड बताती है कि ये सीमाएं कैसे काम करती हैं, किन आंकड़ों पर नजर रखनी चाहिए, और वास्तव में कौन अतिरिक्त जगह का उपयोग करने की स्थिति में है।

segments.src: *Note: This article is general information, not tax, legal or investment advice.
segments.tr: *नोट: यह लेख सामान्य जानकारी है, न कि कर, कानूनी या निवेश संबंधी सलाह।

segments.src: The 2027 figures should be confirmed against the IRS announcement.
segments.tr: 2027 के आंकड़ों की पुष्टि IRS की घोषणा के आधार पर की जानी चाहिए।

segments.src: The figures below for 2026 are the most recent published baseline, so use them as a reference point.*
segments.tr: नीचे दिए गए 2026 के आंकड़े सबसे हाल ही में प्रकाशित आधारभूत (baseline) हैं, इसलिए उन्हें संदर्भ बिंदु के रूप में उपयोग करें।*

segments.src: ## How the annual adjustments work
segments.tr: ## वार्षिक समायोजन कैसे काम करते हैं

segments.src: Congress sets the formulas, and the IRS applies inflation data to them.
segments.tr: कांग्रेस फॉर्मूले निर्धारित करती है, और IRS उन पर मुद्रास्फीति डेटा लागू करती है।

segments.src: A few key points:
segments.tr: कुछ मुख्य बिंदु:

segments.src: - **Indexing is not automatic for every limit.** Many caps rise only once inflation pushes the calculation past a rounding threshold. The 401(k) deferral limit is adjusted in $500 steps, while the IRA limit moves in $500 steps as well, so a modest rise in prices may produce no change at all in some years.
segments.tr: - **इंडेक्सिंग हर सीमा के लिए स्वचालित नहीं है।** कई सीमाएं तभी बढ़ती हैं जब मुद्रास्फीति गणना को राउंडिंग थ्रेशोल्ड से आगे बढ़ा देती है। 401(k) आस्थगन (deferral) सीमा $500 के चरणों में समायोजित की जाती है, जबकि IRA सीमा भी $500 के चरणों में बढ़ती है, इसलिए कीमतों में मामूली वृद्धि कुछ वर्षों में कोई बदलाव नहीं ला सकती है।

segments.src: - **Announcements usually arrive in October or November.** Employers and payroll providers then update their systems, often in time for the new year.
segments.tr: - **घोषणाएं आमतौर पर अक्टूबर या नवंबर में आती हैं।** नियोक्ता और पेरोल प्रदाता तब अपने सिस्टम को अपडेट करते हैं, अक्सर नए साल के समय तक।

segments.src: - **Limits apply per person, not per account.** The 401(k) employee deferral limit is shared across all of your workplace plans of the same type. The IRA limit is shared across all of your traditional and Roth IRAs.
segments.tr: - **सीमाएं प्रति व्यक्ति लागू होती हैं, प्रति खाता नहीं।** 401(k) कर्मचारी आस्थगन सीमा आपके समान प्रकार की सभी कार्यस्थल योजनाओं में साझा की जाती है। IRA सीमा आपके सभी पारंपरिक और Roth IRA में साझा की जाती है।

segments.tr: ## 2026 आधारभूत (baseline)

segments.src: For reference, these are the 2026 figures that the 2027 numbers will build on:
segments.tr: संदर्भ के लिए, ये 2026 के आंकड़े हैं जिन पर 2027 की संख्याएं आधारित होंगी:

segments.tr: | आइटम | 2026 सीमा |

| Catch-up contribution, age 50 and older | $8,000 |

| IRA contribution limit | $7,500 |
segments.tr: | IRA योगदान सीमा | $7,500 |

segments.src: If the 2027 adjustments follow the usual pattern, expect modest increases in some of these lines and no change in others.
segments.tr: यदि 2027 के समायोजन सामान्य पैटर्न का पालन करते हैं, तो इनमें से कुछ लाइनों में मामूली वृद्धि और अन्य में कोई बदलाव न होने की उम्मीद करें।

segments.src: ## Catch-up contributions: what to know
segments.tr: ## कैच-अप योगदान: क्या जानना जरूरी है

segments.src: Catch-up contributions let older savers put away more than the standard limit.
segments.tr: कैच-अप योगदान पुराने बचतकर्ताओं को मानक सीमा से अधिक बचत करने की अनुमति देते हैं।

segments.src: Two features deserve attention.
segments.tr: दो विशेषताएं ध्यान देने योग्य हैं।

segments.src: **The ages 60 to 63 window.** Under the SECURE 2.0 Act, workers who turn 60, 61, 62 or 63 during the year may be eligible for a higher catch-up amount than the standard age-50 catch-up.
segments.tr: **60 से 63 वर्ष की आयु की विंडो।** SECURE 2.0 अधिनियम के तहत, जो कर्मचारी वर्ष के दौरान 60, 61, 62 या 63 वर्ष के हो जाते हैं, वे मानक 50-वर्षीय कैच-अप की तुलना में उच्च कैच-अप राशि के लिए पात्र हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: It is available only if your plan has adopted it, so check with your plan administrator.
segments.tr: यह केवल तभी उपलब्ध है यदि आपकी योजना ने इसे अपनाया है, इसलिए अपने योजना प्रशासक से जांच करें।

segments.src: **Roth treatment for higher earners.** Beginning in 2026, workers whose prior-year wages from the employer sponsoring the plan exceeded a set threshold (indexed from $145,000, and $150,000 for 2026) must make their catch-up contributions on a Roth, or after-tax, basis.
segments.tr: **उच्च आय वालों के लिए Roth उपचार।** 2026 से शुरू होकर, जिन कर्मचारियों का योजना को प्रायोजित करने वाले नियोक्ता से पिछले वर्ष का वेतन एक निर्धारित सीमा (2026 के लिए $145,000 से इंडेक्स किया गया, और $150,000) से अधिक था, उन्हें अपने कैच-अप योगदान Roth, या कर-पश्चात (after-tax), आधार पर करने होंगे।

segments.src: That means no upfront tax deduction, but qualified withdrawals can be tax-free later.
segments.tr: इसका मतलब है कि कोई अग्रिम कर कटौती नहीं, लेकिन योग्य निकासी बाद में कर-मुक्त हो सकती है।

segments.src: If your plan does not offer a Roth option, affected workers may not be able to make catch-up contributions at all, so it is worth asking.
segments.tr: यदि आपकी योजना Roth विकल्प प्रदान नहीं करती है, तो प्रभावित कर्मचारी शायद कैच-अप योगदान बिल्कुल न कर पाएं, इसलिए पूछना उचित है।

segments.src: ## Income thresholds: who can use the extra room
segments.tr: ## आय सीमाएं: अतिरिक्त जगह का उपयोग कौन कर सकता है

segments.src: Raising a cap does not help if your income or your plan features keep you from using it.
segments.tr: यदि आपकी आय या आपकी योजना की विशेषताएं आपको इसका उपयोग करने से रोकती हैं, तो सीमा बढ़ाना मदद नहीं करता है।

segments.src: Several thresholds matter.
segments.tr: कई सीमाएं मायने रखती हैं।

segments.src: **Traditional IRA deductions.** If you or your spouse is covered by a workplace plan, the deduction for traditional IRA contributions phases out at certain income levels.
segments.tr: **पारंपरिक IRA कटौती।** यदि आप या आपका जीवनसाथी किसी कार्यस्थल योजना द्वारा कवर किए गए हैं, तो पारंपरिक IRA योगदान के लिए कटौती कुछ आय स्तरों पर समाप्त (phase out) हो जाती है।

segments.src: For 2026, the range for single filers covered by a workplace plan is $81,000 to $91,000 of modified adjusted gross income.
segments.tr: 2026 के लिए, कार्यस्थल योजना द्वारा कवर किए गए एकल फाइलरों के लिए सीमा संशोधित समायोजित सकल आय (modified adjusted gross income) का $81,000 से $91,000 है।

segments.src: For married couples filing jointly where the contributing spouse is covered, it is $129,000 to $149,000.
segments.tr: संयुक्त रूप से फाइल करने वाले विवाहित जोड़ों के लिए जहां योगदान करने वाला जीवनसाथी कवर किया गया है, यह $129,000 से $149,000 है।

segments.src: **Roth IRA eligibility.** The ability to contribute directly to a Roth IRA phases out at higher incomes.
segments.tr: **Roth IRA पात्रता।** Roth IRA में सीधे योगदान करने की क्षमता उच्च आय पर समाप्त हो जाती है।

segments.src: For 2026, the range is $153,000 to $168,000 for single filers and $242,000 to $252,000 for married couples filing jointly.
**The Saver's Credit.** Lower- and moderate-income workers may qualify for a tax credit of up to 50% of a limited amount of retirement contributions.
segments.tr: **सेवर क्रेडिट (Saver's Credit)।** कम और मध्यम आय वाले कर्मचारी सेवानिवृत्ति योगदान की सीमित राशि के 50% तक के टैक्स क्रेडिट के लिए अर्हता प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: Income limits rise each year with inflation, so a higher threshold can bring new households into eligibility.
segments.tr: आय सीमाएं हर साल मुद्रास्फीति के साथ बढ़ती हैं, इसलिए एक उच्च सीमा नए परिवारों को पात्रता में ला सकती है।

segments.src: When these income ranges move up, more households can deduct IRA contributions or contribute to a Roth IRA, even if the headline dollar limit stays the same.
segments.tr: जब ये आय सीमाएं ऊपर जाती हैं, तो अधिक परिवार IRA योगदान में कटौती कर सकते हैं या Roth IRA में योगदान कर सकते हैं, भले ही मुख्य डॉलर सीमा वही रहे।

segments.src: ## Who can realistically use the higher limits
segments.tr: ## उच्च सीमाओं का वास्तविक उपयोग कौन कर सकता है

segments.src: The honest answer is that most workers do not reach the maximums.
segments.tr: ईमानदार जवाब यह है कि अधिकांश कर्मचारी अधिकतम सीमा तक नहीं पहुंचते हैं।

segments.src: Industry data on plan participants consistently shows that only a small share of savers contribute the full amount allowed.
segments.tr: योजना प्रतिभागियों पर उद्योग डेटा लगातार दिखाता है कि बचतकर्ताओं का केवल एक छोटा हिस्सा ही अनुमत पूरी राशि का योगदान करता है।

segments.src: Higher limits are most relevant to:
segments.tr: उच्च सीमाएं इनके लिए सबसे अधिक प्रासंगिक हैं:

segments.src: - **High earners** who already max out their accounts and want more tax-advantaged space.
segments.tr: - **उच्च आय वाले** जो पहले से ही अपने खातों को अधिकतम कर चुके हैं और अधिक कर-लाभकारी जगह चाहते हैं।

segments.src: - **Workers over 50**, who tend to have more disposable income and a shorter runway to retirement.
segments.tr: - **50 से अधिक आयु के कर्मचारी**, जिनके पास आमतौर पर अधिक डिस्पोजेबल आय होती है और सेवानिवृत्ति के लिए कम समय होता है।

segments.src: - **Households with a plan that allows extra features**, such as after-tax contributions or in-plan Roth conversions.
segments.tr: - **ऐसी योजना वाले परिवार जो अतिरिक्त सुविधाओं की अनुमति देते हैं**, जैसे कि कर-पश्चात योगदान या इन-प्लान Roth रूपांतरण।

segments.src: For everyone else, the more useful step may be raising a contribution rate by one or two percentage points rather than aiming for the cap.
segments.tr: बाकी सभी के लिए, अधिक उपयोगी कदम सीमा तक पहुंचने के बजाय योगदान दर को एक या दो प्रतिशत अंक बढ़ाना हो सकता है।

segments.src: ## Practical steps before January
segments.tr: ## जनवरी से पहले व्यावहारिक कदम

segments.src: 1. **Check your current contribution rate.** Compare what you contribute to the limit and see how much room you have.
segments.tr: 1. **अपनी वर्तमान योगदान दर की जांच करें।** आप जो योगदान करते हैं उसकी तुलना सीमा से करें और देखें कि आपके पास कितनी जगह है।

segments.src: 2. **Capture the employer match first.** Free matching dollars generally come before any other savings goal.
segments.tr: 2. **पहले नियोक्ता मैच प्राप्त करें।** मुफ्त मैचिंग डॉलर आमतौर पर किसी भी अन्य बचत लक्ष्य से पहले आते हैं।

segments.src: 3. **Ask about plan features.** Find out whether your plan offers Roth contributions, catch-up contributions, and the ages 60 to 63 option.
segments.tr: 3. **योजना सुविधाओं के बारे में पूछें।** पता लगाएं कि क्या आपकी योजना Roth योगदान, कैच-अप योगदान और 60 से 63 वर्ष की आयु का विकल्प प्रदान करती है।

segments.src: 4. **Plan for the Roth catch-up rule** if your wages are near the threshold.
segments.tr: 4. **Roth कैच-अप नियम के लिए योजना बनाएं** यदि आपका वेतन सीमा के करीब है।

segments.src: 5. **Set up automatic increases.** Many plans can raise your contribution rate annually, which makes use of new room without extra effort.
segments.tr: 5. **स्वचालित वृद्धि सेट करें।** कई योजनाएं आपकी योगदान दर को सालाना बढ़ा सकती हैं, जो बिना अतिरिक्त प्रयास के नई जगह का उपयोग करती हैं।

segments.src: 6. **Review your tax situation.** A tax professional can help you decide between pre-tax and Roth contributions based on your current and expected future bracket.
segments.tr: 6. **अपनी कर स्थिति की समीक्षा करें।** एक कर पेशेवर आपको आपके वर्तमान और अपेक्षित भविष्य के ब्रैकेट के आधार पर कर-पूर्व (pre-tax) और Roth योगदान के बीच निर्णय लेने में मदद कर सकता है।

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: The yearly adjustment is a small but useful opportunity.
segments.tr: वार्षिक समायोजन एक छोटा लेकिन उपयोगी अवसर है।

segments.src: Whether the new limits matter to you depends less on the headline numbers and more on your income, your age, and what your plan allows.
segments.tr: क्या नई सीमाएं आपके लिए मायने रखती हैं, यह मुख्य आंकड़ों पर कम और आपकी आय, आपकी उम्र और आपकी योजना क्या अनुमति देती है, इस पर अधिक निर्भर करता है।

segments.src: Once the IRS publishes the official 2027 figures, compare them with your current contribution settings and adjust early in the year, when you have the most time to spread contributions across paychecks.
segments.tr: एक बार जब IRS आधिकारिक 2027 के आंकड़े प्रकाशित कर दे, तो उनकी तुलना अपनी वर्तमान योगदान सेटिंग्स से करें और वर्ष की शुरुआत में ही समायोजित करें, जब आपके पास पेचेक में योगदान फैलाने के लिए सबसे अधिक समय होता है।

ar.title: توفير المزيد لعام 2027: ماذا تعني تعديلات حد التقاعد لحساب 401(k) وحساب IRA الخاص بك

segments.src: Every fall, the Internal Revenue Service publishes cost-of-living adjustments for the coming year, including the contribution limits for workplace retirement plans and individual retirement accounts.
segments.tr: في كل خريف، تنشر مصلحة الضرائب الأمريكية (IRS) تعديلات تكلفة المعيشة للسنة القادمة، بما في ذلك حدود المساهمة لخطط التقاعد في مكان العمل وحسابات التقاعد الفردية.

segments.src: Because many of these limits are indexed to inflation, they tend to creep up over time.
segments.tr: وبما أن العديد من هذه الحدود مرتبطة بالتضخم، فإنها ترتفع تدريجياً مع مرور الوقت.

segments.src: This guide explains how the limits work, which numbers to watch, and who is actually in a position to use the extra room.
segments.tr: يشرح هذا الدليل كيفية عمل الحدود، والأرقام التي يجب مراقبتها، ومن هو بالفعل في وضع يسمح له بالاستفادة من المساحة الإضافية.

segments.src: *Note: This article is general information, not tax, legal or investment advice.
segments.tr: *ملاحظة: هذا المقال عبارة عن معلومات عامة، وليس نصيحة ضريبية أو قانونية أو استثمارية.

segments.src: The 2027 figures should be confirmed against the IRS announcement.
segments.tr: يجب التأكد من أرقام عام 2027 مقابل إعلان مصلحة الضرائب الأمريكية.

segments.src: The figures below for 2026 are the most recent published baseline, so use them as a reference point.*
segments.tr: الأرقام أدناه لعام 2026 هي أحدث خط أساس تم نشره، لذا استخدمها كمرجع.*

segments.src: ## How the annual adjustments work
segments.tr: ## كيف تعمل التعديلات السنوية

segments.src: Congress sets the formulas, and the IRS applies inflation data to them.
segments.tr: يحدد الكونغرس الصيغ، وتطبق مصلحة الضرائب بيانات التضخم عليها.

segments.src: A few key points:
segments.tr: بعض النقاط الرئيسية:

segments.src: - **Indexing is not automatic for every limit.** Many caps rise only once inflation pushes the calculation past a rounding threshold. The 401(k) deferral limit is adjusted in $500 steps, while the IRA limit moves in $500 steps as well, so a modest rise in prices may produce no change at all in some years.
segments.tr: - **الربط المؤشر ليس تلقائيًا لكل حد.** ترتفع العديد من السقوف فقط عندما يدفع التضخم الحساب لتجاوز عتبة التقريب. يتم تعديل حد إرجاء 401(k) بزيادات قدرها $500، بينما يتحرك حد IRA بزيادات قدرها $500 أيضًا، لذا فإن الارتفاع التراكمي المعتدل في الأسعار قد لا يحدث أي تغيير في بعض السنوات.

segments.src: - **Announcements usually arrive in October or November.** Employers and payroll providers then update their systems, often in time for the new year.
segments.tr: - **عادة ما تصل الإعلانات في أكتوبر أو نوفمبر.** ثم يقوم أصحاب العمل ومزودو كشوف المرتبات بتحديث أنظمتهم، وغالبًا ما يكون ذلك في الوقت المناسب للعام الجديد.

segments.src: - **Limits apply per person, not per account.** The 401(k) employee deferral limit is shared across all of your workplace plans of the same type. The IRA limit is shared across all of your traditional and Roth IRAs.
segments.tr: - **تنطبق الحدود لكل شخص، وليس لكل حساب.** يتم مشاركة حد إرجاء الموظف لـ 401(k) عبر جميع خطط مكان العمل الخاصة بك من نفس النوع. يتم مشاركة حد IRA عبر جميع حسابات IRA التقليدية وحسابات Roth IRA الخاصة بك.

segments.src: ## The 2026 baseline
segments.tr: ## خط الأساس لعام 2026

segments.src: For reference, these are the 2026 figures that the 2027 numbers will build on:
segments.tr: للمرجعية، هذه هي أرقام عام 2026 التي ستبنى عليها أرقام عام 2027:

segments.src: | Item | 2026 limit |
segments.tr: | العنصر | حد عام 2026 |

segments.tr: | 401(k)، 403(b)، معظم خطط 457: إرجاء الموظف | $24,500 |

segments.src: | Catch-up contribution, age 50 and older | $8,000 |
segments.tr: | مساهمة الاستدراك، لعمر 50 عامًا فما فوق | $8,000 |

segments.tr: | استدراك أعلى، للأعمار من 60 إلى 63 عامًا | $11,250 |

segments.tr: | حد مساهمة IRA | $7,500 |

segments.tr: | إرجاء الموظف لـ SIMPLE IRA | $17,000 |

segments.src: If the 2027 adjustments follow the usual pattern, expect modest increases in some of these lines and no change in others.
segments.tr: إذا اتبعت تعديلات عام 2027 النمط المعتاد، فتوقع زيادات معتدلة في بعض هذه البنود وعدم تغيير في بنود أخرى.

segments.src: ## Catch-up contributions: what to know
segments.tr: ## مساهمات الاستدراك: ما يجب معرفته

segments.src: Catch-up contributions let older savers put away more than the standard limit.
segments.tr: تسمح مساهمات الاستدراك للمدخرين الكبار في السن بإدراج مبالغ أكبر من الحد القياسي.

segments.src: Two features deserve attention.
segments.tr: هناك ميزتان تستحقان الانتباه.

segments.src: **The ages 60 to 63 window.** Under the SECURE 2.0 Act, workers who turn 60, 61, 62 or 63 during the year may be eligible for a higher catch-up amount than the standard age-50 catch-up.
segments.tr: **نافذة الأعمار من 60 إلى 63 عامًا.** بموجب قانون SECURE 2.0، قد يكون العمال الذين يبلغون من العمر 60 أو 61 أو 62 أو 63 عامًا خلال العام مؤهلين لمبلغ استدراك أعلى من المبلغ القياسي لعمر 50 عامًا.

segments.src: It is available only if your plan has adopted it, so check with your plan administrator.
segments.tr: هذا متاح فقط إذا كانت خطتك قد اعتمدته، لذا تحقق مع مسؤول الخطة لديك.

segments.src: **Roth treatment for higher earners.** Beginning in 2026, workers whose prior-year wages from the employer sponsoring the plan exceeded a set threshold (indexed from $145,000, and $150,000 for 2026) must make their catch-up contributions on a Roth, or after-tax, basis.
segments.tr: **معاملة Roth لأصحاب الدخل الأعلى.** بدءًا من عام 2026، يجب على العمال الذين تجاوزت أجورهم في السنة السابقة من صاحب العمل الراعي للخطة حدًا معينًا (مؤشرًا من $145,000، و $150,000 لعام 2026) تقديم مساهمات الاستدراك الخاصة بهم على أساس Roth، أي بعد الخصم الضريبي.

segments.src: That means no upfront tax deduction, but qualified withdrawals can be tax-free later.
segments.tr: هذا يعني عدم وجود خصم ضريبي مقدم، ولكن السحوبات المؤهلة يمكن أن تكون معفاة من الضرائب لاحقًا.

segments.src: If your plan does not offer a Roth option, affected workers may not be able to make catch-up contributions at all, so it is worth asking.
segments.tr: إذا كانت خطتك لا تقدم خيار Roth، فقد لا يتمكن العمال المتأثرون من تقديم مساهمات استدراكية على الإطلاق، لذا يجدر بك الاستفسار.

segments.src: ## Income thresholds: who can use the extra room
segments.tr: ## عتبات الدخل: من يمكنه استخدام المساحة الإضافية

segments.src: Raising a cap does not help if your income or your plan features keep you from using it.
segments.tr: رفع السقف لا يساعد إذا كان دخلك أو ميزات خطتك تمنعك من استخدامه.

segments.src: Several thresholds matter.
segments.tr: هناك العديد من العتبات المهمة.

segments.src: **Traditional IRA deductions.** If you or your spouse is covered by a workplace plan, the deduction for traditional IRA contributions phases out at certain income levels.
segments.tr: **خصومات IRA التقليدية.** إذا كنت أنت أو زوجك مشمولاً بخطة مكان العمل، فإن الخصم لمساهمات IRA التقليدية يلغى تدريجياً عند مستويات دخل معينة.

segments.src: For 2026, the range for single filers covered by a workplace plan is $81,000 to $91,000 of modified adjusted gross income.
segments.tr: لعام 2026، النطاق لمقدمي الطلبات العزباء المشمولين بخطة مكان العمل هو $81,000 إلى $91,000 من الدخل الإجمالي المعدل المعدل.

segments.src: For married couples filing jointly where the contributing spouse is covered, it is $129,000 to $149,000.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للأزواج الذين يقدمون إقرارات مشتركة حيث يكون الزوج المساهم مشمولاً، فإن النطاق هو $129,000 إلى $149,000.

segments.src: **Roth IRA eligibility.** The ability to contribute directly to a Roth IRA phases out at higher incomes.
segments.tr: **أهلية Roth IRA.** القدرة على المساهمة مباشرة في Roth IRA تلغى تدريجياً عند مستويات الدخل الأعلى.

segments.src: For 2026, the range is $153,000 to $168,000 for single filers and $242,000 to $252,000 for married couples filing jointly.
segments.tr: لعام 2026، النطاق هو $153,000 إلى $168,000 للعزاب و $242,000 إلى $252,000 للأزواج الذين يقدمون إقرارات مشتركة.

segments.src: **The Saver's Credit.** Lower- and moderate-income workers may qualify for a tax credit of up to 50% of a limited amount of retirement contributions.
segments.tr: **ائتمان المدخر (Saver's Credit).** قد يتأهل العمال ذوو الدخل المنخفض والمتوسط للحصول على ائتمان ضريبي يصل إلى 50% من مبلغ محدود من مساهمات التقاعد.

segments.src: Income limits rise each year with inflation, so a higher threshold can bring new households into eligibility.
segments.tr: ترتفع حدود الدخل كل عام مع التضخم، لذا فإن العتبة الأعلى يمكن أن تدخل أسرًا جديدة في دائرة الأهلية.

segments.src: When these income ranges move up, more households can deduct IRA contributions or contribute to a Roth IRA, even if the headline dollar limit stays the same.
segments.tr: عندما ترتفع نطاقات الدخل هذه، يمكن للمزيد من الأسر خصم مساهمات IRA أو المساهمة في Roth IRA، حتى لو ظل الحد الأقصى للمبلغ بالدولار كما هو.

segments.src: ## Who can realistically use the higher limits
segments.tr: ## من يمكنه واقعياً استخدام الحدود الأعلى

segments.src: The honest answer is that most workers do not reach the maximums.
segments.tr: الجواب الصريح هو أن معظم العمال لا يصلون إلى الحد الأقصى.

segments.src: Industry data on plan participants consistently shows that only a small share of savers contribute the full amount allowed.
segments.tr: تظهر بيانات القطاع حول المشاركين في الخطة باستمرار أن نسبة صغيرة فقط من المدخرين يساهمون بالمبلغ الكامل المسموح به.

segments.src: Higher limits are most relevant to:
segments.tr: الحدود الأعلى هي الأكثر أهمية بالنسبة لـ:

segments.src: - **High earners** who already max out their accounts and want more tax-advantaged space.
segments.tr: - **أصحاب الدخل المرتفع** الذين يستغلون حساباتهم بالكامل بالفعل ويريدون المزيد من المساحة ذات المزايا الضريبية.

segments.src: - **Workers over 50**, who tend to have more disposable income and a shorter runway to retirement.
segments.tr: - **العمال فوق سن 50**، الذين يميلون إلى امتلاك المزيد من الدخل المتاح ومسار أقصر حتى التقاعد.

segments.src: - **Households with a plan that allows extra features**, such as after-tax contributions or in-plan Roth conversions.
segments.tr: - **الأسر التي لديها خطة تسمح بميزات إضافية**، مثل المساهمات بعد الخصم الضريبي أو تحويلات Roth داخل الخطة.

segments.src: For everyone else, the more useful step may be raising a contribution rate by one or two percentage points rather than aiming for the cap.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لأي شخص آخر، قد تكون الخطوة الأكثر فائدة هي رفع معدل المساهمة بنسبة نقطة مئوية أو نقطتين بدلاً من السعي للوصول إلى السقف.

segments.src: ## Practical steps before January
segments.tr: ## خطوات عملية قبل يناير

segments.src: 1. **Check your current contribution rate.** Compare what you contribute to the limit and see how much room you have.
segments.tr: 1. **تحقق من معدل مساهمتك الحالي.** قارن ما تساهم به مع الحد الأقصى وانظر كم من المساحة لديك.

segments.src: 2. **Capture the employer match first.** Free matching dollars generally come before any other savings goal.
segments.tr: 2. **احصل على مطابقة صاحب العمل أولاً.** تأتي أموال المطابقة المجانية عمومًا قبل أي هدف إدخاري آخر.

segments.src: 3. **Ask about plan features.** Find out whether your plan offers Roth contributions, catch-up contributions, and the ages 60 to 63 option.
segments.tr: 3. **استفسر عن ميزات الخطة.** اكتشف ما إذا كانت خطتك تقدم مساهمات Roth، ومساهمات الاستدراك، وخيار الأعمار من 60 إلى 63 عامًا.

segments.src: 4. **Plan for the Roth catch-up rule** if your wages are near the threshold.

fr.title: Épargner davantage pour 2027 : ce que les ajustements des plafonds de retraite pourraient signifier pour votre 401(k) et votre IRA

segments.src: Every fall, the Internal Revenue Service publishes cost-of-living adjustments for the coming year, including the contribution limits for workplace retirement plans and individual retirement accounts.
segments.tr: Chaque automne, l'Internal Revenue Service publie les ajustements au coût de la vie pour l'année à venir, y compris les plafonds de cotisation pour les plans de retraite en entreprise et les comptes de retraite individuels.

segments.src: Because many of these limits are indexed to inflation, they tend to creep up over time.
segments.tr: Comme beaucoup de ces plafonds sont indexés sur l'inflation, ils ont tendance à augmenter progressivement avec le temps.

segments.src: This guide explains how the limits work, which numbers to watch, and who is actually in a position to use the extra room.
segments.tr: Ce guide explique comment fonctionnent les plafonds, quels chiffres surveiller et qui est réellement en mesure de profiter de cette marge supplémentaire.

segments.src: *Note: This article is general information, not tax, legal or investment advice.
segments.tr: *Remarque : Cet article constitue une information générale et non un conseil fiscal, juridique ou en investissement.

segments.src: The 2027 figures should be confirmed against the IRS announcement.
segments.tr: Les chiffres pour 2027 doivent être confirmés par l'annonce de l'IRS.

segments.src: The figures below for 2026 are the most recent published baseline, so use them as a reference point.*
segments.tr: Les chiffres ci-dessous pour 2026 sont la base de référence la plus récente publiée, utilisez-les donc comme point de référence.*

segments.src: ## How the annual adjustments work
segments.tr: ## Comment fonctionnent les ajustements annuels

segments.src: Congress sets the formulas, and the IRS applies inflation data to them.
segments.tr: Le Congrès établit les formules et l'IRS y applique les données relatives à l'inflation.

segments.src: A few key points:
segments.tr: Quelques points clés :

segments.src: - **Indexing is not automatic for every limit.** Many caps rise only once inflation pushes the calculation past a rounding threshold. The 401(k) deferral limit is adjusted in $500 steps, while the IRA limit moves in $500 steps as well, so a modest rise in prices may produce no change at all in some years.
segments.tr: - **L'indexation n'est pas automatique pour tous les plafonds.** De nombreux plafonds n'augmentent que lorsque l'inflation fait dépasser le calcul au-delà d'un seuil d'arrondi. Le plafond de report du 401(k) est ajusté par tranches de $500, tandis que le plafond de l'IRA évolue également par tranches de $500 ; une hausse modeste des prix peut donc ne produire aucun changement certaines années.

segments.src: - **Announcements usually arrive in October or November.** Employers and payroll providers then update their systems, often in time for the new year.
segments.tr: - **Les annonces arrivent généralement en octobre ou novembre.** Les employeurs et les prestataires de paie mettent ensuite à jour leurs systèmes, souvent à temps pour la nouvelle année.

segments.src: - **Limits apply per person, not per account.** The 401(k) employee deferral limit is shared across all of your workplace plans of the same type. The IRA limit is shared across all of your traditional and Roth IRAs.
segments.tr: - **Les plafonds s'appliquent par personne, et non par compte.** Le plafond de report salarial du 401(k) est partagé entre tous vos plans d'entreprise du même type. Le plafond de l'IRA est partagé entre tous vos IRA traditionnels et Roth.

segments.tr: ## La base de référence 2026

segments.tr: Pour référence, voici les chiffres de 2026 sur lesquels s'appuieront les chiffres de 2027 :

segments.tr: | Item | 2026 limit |

segments.src: ## Catch-up contributions: what to know
segments.tr: ## Cotisations de rattrapage : ce qu'il faut savoir

segments.src: Catch-up contributions let older savers put away more than the standard limit.
segments.tr: Les cotisations de rattrapage permettent aux épargnants plus âgés de mettre de côté davantage que le plafond standard.

segments.src: Two features deserve attention.
segments.tr: Deux caractéristiques méritent l'attention.

segments.src: **The ages 60 to 63 window.** Under the SECURE 2.0 Act, workers who turn 60, 61, 62 or 63 during the year may be eligible for a higher catch-up amount than the standard age-50 catch-up.
segments.tr: **La fenêtre des 60 à 63 ans.** En vertu de la loi SECURE 2.0, les travailleurs qui atteignent 60, 61, 62 ou 63 ans au cours de l'année peuvent être éligibles à un montant de rattrapage plus élevé que le rattrapage standard de 50 ans.

segments.src: It is available only if your plan has adopted it, so check with your plan administrator.
segments.tr: Elle n'est disponible que si votre plan l'a adoptée, vérifiez donc auprès de l'administrateur de votre plan.

segments.src: **Roth treatment for higher earners.** Beginning in 2026, workers whose prior-year wages from the employer sponsoring the plan exceeded a set threshold (indexed from $145,000, and $150,000 for 2026) must make their catch-up contributions on a Roth, or after-tax, basis.
segments.tr: **Traitement Roth pour les hauts revenus.** À partir de 2026, les travailleurs dont le salaire de l'année précédente provenant de l'employeur parrainant le plan a dépassé un seuil fixé (indexé à partir de $145,000, et $150,000 pour 2026) doivent effectuer leurs cotisations de rattrapage sur une base Roth, ou après impôts.

segments.src: That means no upfront tax deduction, but qualified withdrawals can be tax-free later.
segments.tr: Cela signifie aucune déduction fiscale immédiate, mais les retraits qualifiés peuvent être exonérés d'impôt plus tard.

segments.src: If your plan does not offer a Roth option, affected workers may not be able to make catch-up contributions at all, so it is worth asking.
segments.tr: Si votre plan n'offre pas d'option Roth, les travailleurs concernés pourraient ne pas être en mesure d'effectuer des cotisations de rattrapage du tout, il vaut donc la peine de poser la question.

segments.src: ## Income thresholds: who can use the extra room
segments.tr: ## Seuils de revenus : qui peut utiliser la marge supplémentaire

segments.src: Raising a cap does not help if your income or your plan features keep you from using it.
segments.tr: Augmenter un plafond ne sert à rien si vos revenus ou les caractéristiques de votre plan vous empêchent de l'utiliser.

segments.src: Several thresholds matter.
segments.tr: Plusieurs seuils sont importants.

segments.src: **Traditional IRA deductions.** If you or your spouse is covered by a workplace plan, the deduction for traditional IRA contributions phases out at certain income levels.
segments.tr: **Déductions IRA traditionnelles.** Si vous ou votre conjoint êtes couvert par un plan d'entreprise, la déduction pour les cotisations IRA traditionnelles diminue progressivement à certains niveaux de revenus.

segments.src: For 2026, the range for single filers covered by a workplace plan is $81,000 to $91,000 of modified adjusted gross income.
segments.tr: Pour 2026, la fourchette pour les contribuables célibataires couverts par un plan d'entreprise est de $81,000 à $91,000 de revenu brut ajusté modifié.

segments.src: For married couples filing jointly where the contributing spouse is covered, it is $129,000 to $149,000.
segments.tr: Pour les couples mariés déposant une déclaration commune où le conjoint cotisant est couvert, elle est de $129,000 à $149,000.

segments.src: **Roth IRA eligibility.** The ability to contribute directly to a Roth IRA phases out at higher incomes.
segments.tr: **Éligibilité au Roth IRA.** La possibilité de cotiser directement à un Roth IRA diminue progressivement pour les revenus plus élevés.

segments.src: For 2026, the range is $153,000 to $168,000 for single filers and $242,000 to $252,000 for married couples filing jointly.
segments.tr: Pour 2026, la fourchette est de $153,000 à $168,000 pour les contribuables célibataires et de $242,000 à $252,000 pour les couples mariés déposant une déclaration commune.

segments.src: **The Saver's Credit.** Lower- and moderate-income workers may qualify for a tax credit of up to 50% of a limited amount of retirement contributions.
segments.tr: **Le crédit d'épargne (Saver's Credit).** Les travailleurs à revenus faibles ou modérés peuvent être éligibles à un crédit d'impôt allant jusqu'à 50 % d'un montant limité de cotisations de retraite.

segments.src: Income limits rise each year with inflation, so a higher threshold can bring new households into eligibility.
segments.tr: Les plafonds de revenus augmentent chaque année avec l'inflation, donc un seuil plus élevé peut rendre de nouveaux ménages éligibles.

segments.src: When these income ranges move up, more households can deduct IRA contributions or contribute to a Roth IRA, even if the headline dollar limit stays the same.
segments.tr: Lorsque ces fourchettes de revenus augmentent, davantage de ménages peuvent déduire leurs cotisations IRA ou cotiser à un Roth IRA, même si le plafond monétaire principal reste le même.

segments.src: ## Who can realistically use the higher limits
segments.tr: ## Qui peut réellement utiliser les plafonds plus élevés

segments.src: The honest answer is that most workers do not reach the maximums.
segments.tr: La réponse honnête est que la plupart des travailleurs n'atteignent pas les maximums.

segments.src: Industry data on plan participants consistently shows that only a small share of savers contribute the full amount allowed.
segments.tr: Les données du secteur sur les participants aux plans montrent systématiquement qu'une faible part des épargnants cotise le montant total autorisé.

segments.src: Higher limits are most relevant to:
segments.tr: Les plafonds plus élevés sont surtout pertinents pour :

segments.src: - **High earners** who already max out their accounts and want more tax-advantaged space.
segments.tr: - **Les hauts revenus** qui atteignent déjà le maximum de leurs comptes et souhaitent plus d'espace fiscalement avantageux.

segments.src: - **Workers over 50**, who tend to have more disposable income and a shorter runway to retirement.
segments.tr: - **Les travailleurs de plus de 50 ans**, qui ont tendance à avoir plus de revenu disponible et un délai plus court avant la retraite.

segments.src: - **Households with a plan that allows extra features**, such as after-tax contributions or in-plan Roth conversions.
segments.tr: - **Les ménages disposant d'un plan autorisant des fonctionnalités supplémentaires**, telles que des cotisations après impôts ou des conversions Roth au sein du plan.

segments.src: For everyone else, the more useful step may be raising a contribution rate by one or two percentage points rather than aiming for the cap.
segments.tr: Pour tous les autres, l'étape la plus utile peut être d'augmenter le taux de cotisation d'un ou deux points de pourcentage plutôt que de viser le plafond.

segments.src: ## Practical steps before January
segments.tr: ## Étapes pratiques avant janvier

segments.src: 1. **Check your current contribution rate.** Compare what you contribute to the limit and see how much room you have.
segments.tr: 1. **Vérifiez votre taux de cotisation actuel.** Comparez ce que vous cotisez au plafond et voyez quelle marge vous avez.

segments.src: 2. **Capture the employer match first.** Free matching dollars generally come before any other savings goal.
segments.tr: 2. **Capturez d'abord l'abondement de l'employeur.** Les dollars d'abondement gratuits passent généralement avant tout autre objectif d'épargne.

segments.src: 3. **Ask about plan features.** Find out whether your plan offers Roth contributions, catch-up contributions, and the ages 60 to 63 option.
segments.tr: 3. **Renseignez-vous sur les fonctionnalités du plan.** Découvrez si votre plan propose des cotisations Roth, des cotisations de rattrapage et l'option pour les 60 à 63 ans.

segments.src: 4. **Plan for the Roth catch-up rule** if your wages are near the threshold.
segments.tr: 4. **Prévoyez la règle de rattrapage Roth** si votre salaire est proche du seuil.

segments.src: 5. **Set up automatic increases.** Many plans can raise your contribution rate annually, which makes use of new room without extra effort.
segments.tr: 5. **Mettez en place des augmentations automatiques.** De nombreux plans peuvent augmenter votre taux de cotisation annuellement, ce qui permet d'utiliser la nouvelle marge sans effort supplémentaire.

segments.src: 6. **Review your tax situation.** A tax professional can help you decide between pre-tax and Roth contributions based on your current and expected future bracket.
segments.tr: 6. **Examinez votre situation fiscale.** Un professionnel de la fiscalité peut vous aider à décider entre des cotisations avant impôts et Roth en fonction de votre tranche d'imposition actuelle et future prévue.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: The yearly adjustment is a small but useful opportunity.
segments.tr: L'ajustement annuel est une petite opportunité, mais utile.

segments.src: Whether the new limits matter to you depends less on the headline numbers and more on your income, your age, and what your plan allows.
segments.tr: Que les nouveaux plafonds soient importants pour vous dépend moins des chiffres principaux que de vos revenus, de votre âge et de ce que votre plan autorise.

segments.src: Once the IRS publishes the official 2027 figures, compare them with your current contribution settings and adjust early in the year, when you have the most time to spread contributions across paychecks.
segments.tr: Une fois que l'IRS aura publié les chiffres officiels de 2027, comparez-les avec vos paramètres de cotisation actuels et ajustez-les tôt dans l'année, lorsque vous avez le plus de temps pour répartir les cotisations sur vos bulletins de paie.

segments.tr: Os limites de renda sobem a cada ano com a inflação, de modo que um limite mais alto pode trazer novas famílias para a elegibilidade.

segments.src: When these income ranges move up, more households can deduct IRA contributions or contribute to a Roth IRA, even if the headline dollar limit stays the same.
segments.tr: Quando essas faixas de renda sobem, mais famílias podem deduzir contribuições para o IRA ou contribuir para um IRA Roth, mesmo que o limite nominal em dólar permaneça o mesmo.

segments.src: ## Who can realistically use the higher limits
segments.tr: **Quem pode usar realisticamente os limites mais altos

segments.src: The honest answer is that most workers do not reach the maximums.
segments.tr: A resposta honesta é que a maioria dos trabalhadores não atinge os máximos.

segments.src: Industry data on plan participants consistently shows that only a small share of savers contribute the full amount allowed.
segments.tr: Os dados da indústria sobre participantes de planos mostram consistentemente que apenas uma pequena parcela dos poupadores contribui com o valor total permitido.

segments.src: Higher limits are most relevant to:
segments.tr: Limites mais altos são mais relevantes para:

segments.src: - **High earners** who already max out their accounts and want more tax-advantaged space.
segments.tr: - **Trabalhadores de alta renda** que já atingem o limite máximo de suas contas e querem mais espaço com vantagens fiscais.

segments.src: - **Workers over 50**, who tend to have more disposable income and a shorter runway to retirement.
segments.tr: - **Trabalhadores com mais de 50 anos**, que tendem a ter mais renda dispendível e um prazo mais curto até a aposentadoria.

segments.src: - **Households with a plan that allows extra features**, such as after-tax contributions or in-plan Roth conversions.
segments.tr: - **Famílias com um plano que permite recursos extras**, como contribuições após impostos ou conversões Roth dentro do plano.

segments.src: For everyone else, the more useful step may be raising a contribution rate by one or two percentage points rather than aiming for the cap.
segments.tr: Para todos os outros, o passo mais útil pode ser aumentar uma taxa de contribuição em um ou dois pontos percentuais em vez de buscar o teto.

segments.src: ## Practical steps before January
segments.tr: ## Passos práticos antes de janeiro

segments.src: 1. **Check your current contribution rate.** Compare what you contribute to the limit and see how much room you have.
segments.tr: 1. **Verifique sua taxa de contribuição atual.** Compare o que você contribui com o limite e veja quanto espaço você tem.

segments.src: 2. **Capture the employer match first.** Free matching dollars generally come before any other savings goal.
segments.tr: **Garanta a contrapartida do empregador primeiro.** Os dólares de contrapartida gratuita geralmente vêm antes de qualquer outra meta de poupança.

segments.src: 3. **Ask about plan features.** Find out whether your plan offers Roth contributions, catch-up contributions, and the ages 60 to 63 option.
segments.tr: 3. **Pergunte sobre os recursos do plano.** Descubra se o seu plano oferece contribuições Roth, contribuições de recuperação e a opção para as idades de 60 a 63 anos.

segments.src: 4. **Plan for the Roth catch-up rule** if your wages are near the threshold.
segments.tr: 4. **Planeje-se para a regra de recuperação Roth** se o seu salário estiver próximo do limite.

segments.src: 5. **Set up automatic increases.** Many plans can raise your contribution rate annually, which makes use of new room without extra effort.
segments.tr: 5. **Configure aumentos automáticos.** Muitos planos podem aumentar sua taxa de contribuição anualmente, o que aproveita o novo espaço sem esforço extra.

segments.src: 6. **Review your tax situation.** A tax professional can help you decide between pre-tax and Roth contributions based on your current and expected future bracket.
segments.tr: 6. **Revise sua situação fiscal.** Um profissional tributário pode ajudá-lo a decidir entre contribuições pré-impostos e Roth com base na sua faixa atual e futura esperada.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Conclusão

segments.src: The yearly adjustment is a small but useful opportunity.
segments.tr: O ajuste anual é uma oportunidade pequena, mas útil.

segments.src: Whether the new limits matter to you depends less on the headline numbers and more on your income, your age, and what your plan allows.
segments.tr: Se os novos limites importam para você depende menos dos números principais e mais da sua renda, da sua idade e do que o seu plano permite.

segments.src: Once the IRS publishes the official 2027 figures, compare them with your current contribution settings and adjust early in the year, when you have the most time to spread contributions across paychecks.
segments.tr: Assim que o IRS publicar os números oficiais de 2027, compare-os com suas configurações atuais de contribuição e ajuste no início do ano, quando você tiver mais tempo para distribuir as contribuições entre os contracheques.

in.title: Menabung Lebih Banyak untuk 2027: Apa Artinya Penyesuaian Batas Pensiun bagi 401(k) dan IRA Anda

segments.src: Every fall, the Internal Revenue Service publishes cost-of-living adjustments for the coming year, including the contribution limits for workplace retirement plans and individual retirement accounts.
segments.tr: Setiap musim gugur, Internal Revenue Service menerbitkan penyesuaian biaya hidup untuk tahun mendatang, termasuk batas kontribusi untuk rencana pensiun tempat kerja dan rekening pensiun individu.

segments.src: Because many of these limits are indexed to inflation, they tend to creep up over time.
segments.tr: Karena banyak dari batas ini diindeks terhadap inflasi, batas tersebut cenderung meningkat seiring waktu.

segments.src: This guide explains how the limits work, which numbers to watch, and who is actually in a position to use the extra room.
segments.tr: Panduan ini menjelaskan cara kerja batas tersebut, angka mana yang harus diperhatikan, dan siapa yang benar-benar berada dalam posisi untuk memanfaatkan ruang tambahan tersebut.

segments.src: *Note: This article is general information, not tax, legal or investment advice.
segments.tr: *Catatan: Artikel ini adalah informasi umum, bukan nasihat pajak, hukum, atau investasi.

segments.src: The 2027 figures should be confirmed against the IRS announcement.
segments.tr: Angka tahun 2027 harus dikonfirmasi terhadap pengumuman IRS.

segments.src: The figures below for 2026 are the most recent published baseline, so use them as a reference point.*
segments.tr: Angka di bawah ini untuk tahun 2026 adalah dasar yang paling baru diterbitkan, jadi gunakan sebagai titik referensi.*

segments.src: ## How the annual adjustments work
segments.tr: ## Cara kerja penyesuaian tahunan

segments.src: Congress sets the formulas, and the IRS applies inflation data to them.
segments.tr: Kongres menetapkan formula, dan IRS menerapkannya pada data inflasi.

segments.src: A few key points:
segments.tr: Beberapa poin penting:

segments.src: - **Indexing is not automatic for every limit.** Many caps rise only once inflation pushes the calculation past a rounding threshold. The 401(k) deferral limit is adjusted in $500 steps, while the IRA limit moves in $500 steps as well, so a modest rise in prices may produce no change at all in some years.
segments.tr: - **Pengindeksan tidak otomatis untuk setiap batas.** Banyak batasan hanya naik sekali inflasi mendorong perhitungan melewati ambang pembatas pembulatan. Batas penangguhan 401(k) disesuaikan dalam langkah $500, sementara batas IRA juga bergerak dalam langkah $500, sehingga kenaikan harga yang sederhana mungkin tidak menghasilkan perubahan sama sekali di beberapa tahun.

segments.src: - **Announcements usually arrive in October or November.** Employers and payroll providers then update their systems, often in time for the new year.
segments.tr: - **Pengumuman biasanya tiba pada bulan Oktober atau November.** Pemberi kerja dan penyedia penggajian kemudian memperbarui sistem mereka, sering kali tepat waktu untuk tahun baru.

segments.src: - **Limits apply per person, not per account.** The 401(k) employee deferral limit is shared across all of your workplace plans of the same type. The IRA limit is shared across all of your traditional and Roth IRAs.
segments.tr: - **Batas berlaku per orang, bukan per akun.** Batas penangguhan karyawan 401(k) dibagikan di semua rencana tempat kerja Anda dengan jenis yang sama. Batas IRA dibagikan di semua IRA tradisional dan Roth Anda.

segments.src: ## The 2026 baseline
segments.tr: ## Dasar 2026

segments.src: For reference, these are the 2026 figures that the 2027 numbers will build on:
segments.tr: Sebagai referensi, ini adalah angka 2026 yang akan menjadi dasar angka 2027:

segments.src: | Item | 2026 limit |
segments.tr: | Item | Batas 2026 |

segments.src: | 401(k), 403(b), most 457 plans: employee deferral | $24,500 |
segments.tr: | 401(k), 403(b), sebagian besar rencana 457: penangguhan karyawan | $24,500 |

segments.src: | Catch-up contribution, age 50 and older | $8,000 |
segments.tr: | Kontribusi catch-up, usia 50 tahun ke atas | $8,000 |

segments.src: | Higher catch-up, ages 60 to 63 | $11,250 |
segments.tr: | Catch-up yang lebih tinggi, usia 60 hingga 63 | $11,250 |

segments.src: | IRA contribution limit | $7,500 |
segments.tr: | Batas kontribusi IRA | $7,500 |

segments.src: | IRA catch-up, age 50 and older | $1,100 |
segments.tr: | Catch-up IRA, usia 50 tahun ke atas | $1,100 |

segments.src: | SIMPLE IRA employee deferral | $17,000 |
segments.tr: | Penangguhan karyawan SIMPLE IRA | $17,000 |

segments.src: If the 2027 adjustments follow the usual pattern, expect modest increases in some of these lines and no change in others.
segments.tr: Jika penyesuaian 2027 mengikuti pola biasa, perkirakan sedikit peningkatan di beberapa baris ini dan tidak ada perubahan pada baris lainnya.

segments.src: ## Catch-up contributions: what to know
segments.tr: ## Kontribusi catch-up: hal yang perlu diketahui

segments.src: Catch-up contributions let older savers put away more than the standard limit.
segments.tr: Kontribusi catch-up memungkinkan penabung yang lebih tua menyisihkan lebih dari batas standar.

segments.src: Two features deserve attention.
segments.tr: Dua fitur patut mendapat perhatian.

segments.src: **The ages 60 to 63 window.** Under the SECURE 2.0 Act, workers who turn 60, 61, 62 or 63 during the year may be eligible for a higher catch-up amount than the standard age-50 catch-up.
segments.tr: **Jendela usia 60 hingga 63.** Berdasarkan Undang-Undang SECURE 2.0, pekerja yang berusia 60, 61, 62, atau 63 tahun selama tahun tersebut mungkin memenuhi syarat untuk jumlah catch-up yang lebih tinggi daripada catch-up standar usia 50 tahun.

segments.src: It is available only if your plan has adopted it, so check with your plan administrator.
segments.tr: Ini hanya tersedia jika rencana Anda telah mengadopsinya, jadi tanyakan kepada administrator rencana Anda.

segments.src: **Roth treatment for higher earners.** Beginning in 2026, workers whose prior-year wages from the employer sponsoring the plan exceeded a set threshold (indexed from $145,000, and $150,000 for 2026) must make their catch-up contributions on a Roth, or after-tax, basis.
segments.tr: **Perlakuan Roth untuk penghasilan yang lebih tinggi.** Mulai tahun 2026, pekerja yang upah tahun sebelumnya dari pemberi kerja yang mensponsori rencana tersebut melebihi ambang batas yang ditetapkan (diindeks dari $145.000, dan $150.000 untuk 2026) harus melakukan kontribusi catch-up mereka atas dasar Roth, atau setelah pajak.

segments.src: That means no upfront tax deduction, but qualified withdrawals can be tax-free later.
segments.tr: Itu berarti tidak ada pengurangan pajak di muka, tetapi penarikan yang memenuhi syarat dapat bebas pajak di kemudian hari.

segments.src: If your plan does not offer a Roth option, affected workers may not be able to make catch-up contributions at all, so it is worth asking.
segments.tr: Jika rencana Anda tidak menawarkan opsi Roth, pekerja yang terkena dampak mungkin tidak dapat melakukan kontribusi catch-up sama sekali, jadi ada baiknya untuk bertanya.

segments.src: ## Income thresholds: who can use the extra room
segments.tr: ## Ambang batas pendapatan: siapa yang dapat menggunakan ruang tambahan

segments.src: Raising a cap does not help if your income or your plan features keep you from using it.
segments.tr: Menaikkan batasan tidak membantu jika pendapatan Anda atau fitur rencana Anda mencegah Anda menggunakannya.

segments.src: Several thresholds matter.
segments.tr: Beberapa ambang batas penting.

segments.src: **Traditional IRA deductions.** If you or your spouse is covered by a workplace plan, the deduction for traditional IRA contributions phases out at certain income levels.
segments.tr: **Pengurangan IRA Tradisional.** Jika Anda atau pasangan Anda dicakup oleh rencana tempat kerja, pengurangan untuk kontribusi IRA tradisional akan dihapus secara bertahap pada tingkat pendapatan tertentu.

segments.src: For 2026, the range for single filers covered by a workplace plan is $81,000 to $91,000 of modified adjusted gross income.
segments.tr: Untuk 2026, kisaran untuk pelapor tunggal yang dicakup oleh rencana tempat kerja adalah $81.000 hingga $91.000 dari pendapatan kotor disesuaikan yang dimodifikasi.

segments.src: For married couples filing jointly where the contributing spouse is covered, it is $129,000 to $149,000.
segments.tr: Untuk pasangan menikah yang mengajukan bersama di mana pasangan yang berkontribusi dicakup, kisaran tersebut adalah $129.000 hingga $149.000.

segments.src: **Roth IRA eligibility.** The ability to contribute directly to a Roth IRA phases out at higher incomes.
segments.tr: **Kelayakan IRA Roth.** Kemampuan untuk berkontribusi secara langsung ke Roth IRA dihapus secara bertahap pada pendapatan yang lebih tinggi.

segments.src: For 2026, the range is $153,000 to $168,000 for single filers and $242,000 to $252,000 for married couples filing jointly.
segments.tr: Untuk 2026, kisarannya adalah $153.000 hingga $168.000 untuk pelapor tunggal dan $242.000 hingga $252.000 untuk pasangan menikah yang mengajukan bersama.

segments.src: **The Saver's Credit.** Lower- and moderate-income workers may qualify for a tax credit of up to 50% of a limited amount of retirement contributions.
segments.tr: **Kredit Penabung.** Pekerja berpenghasilan rendah dan menengah mungkin memenuhi syarat untuk kredit pajak hingga 50% dari jumlah terbatas kontribusi pensiun.

segments.src: Income limits rise each year with inflation, so a higher threshold can bring new households into eligibility.
segments.tr: Batas pendapatan naik setiap tahun dengan inflasi, sehingga ambang batas yang lebih tinggi dapat membawa rumah tangga baru ke dalam kelayakan.

segments.src: When these income ranges move up, more households can deduct IRA contributions or contribute to a Roth IRA, even if the headline dollar limit stays the same.
segments.tr: Ketika kisaran pendapatan ini naik, lebih banyak rumah tangga dapat mengurangi kontribusi IRA atau berkontribusi ke Roth IRA, bahkan jika batas dolar utama tetap sama.

segments.src: ## Who can realistically use the higher limits
segments.tr: ## Siapa yang secara realistis dapat menggunakan batas yang lebih tinggi

segments.src: The honest answer is that most workers do not reach the maximums.
segments.tr: Jawaban jujurnya adalah sebagian besar pekerja tidak mencapai maksimum.

segments.src: Industry data on plan participants consistently shows that only a small share of savers contribute the full amount allowed.
segments.tr: Data industri tentang peserta rencana secara konsisten menunjukkan bahwa hanya sebagian kecil penabung yang menyumbangkan jumlah penuh yang diizinkan.

segments.src: Higher limits are most relevant to:
segments.tr: Batas yang lebih tinggi paling relevan bagi:

segments.src: - **High earners** who already max out their accounts and want more tax-advantaged space.
segments.tr: - **Penerima penghasilan tinggi** yang sudah memaksimalkan akun mereka dan menginginkan lebih banyak ruang yang diuntungkan pajak.

segments.src: - **Workers over 50**, who tend to have more disposable income and a shorter runway to retirement.
segments.tr: - **Pekerja di atas 50 tahun**, yang cenderung memiliki lebih banyak penghasilan yang dapat dibelanjakan dan waktu yang lebih singkat menuju masa pensiun.

segments.src: - **Households with a plan that allows extra features**, such as after-tax contributions or in-plan Roth conversions.
segments.tr: - **Rumah tangga dengan rencana yang memungkinkan fitur tambahan**, seperti kontribusi setelah pajak atau konversi Roth dalam rencana.

segments.src: For everyone else, the more useful step may be raising a contribution rate by one or two percentage points rather than aiming for the cap.
segments.tr: Bagi yang lain, langkah yang lebih berguna mungkin menaikkan tingkat kontribusi sebesar satu atau dua poin persentase daripada mengincar batas maksimal.

segments.src: ## Practical steps before January
segments.tr: ## Langkah praktis sebelum Januari

segments.src: 1. **Check your current contribution rate.** Compare what you contribute to the limit and see how much room you have.
segments.tr: 1. **Periksa tingkat kontribusi Anda saat ini.** Bandingkan apa yang Anda kontribusikan dengan batas dan lihat berapa banyak ruang yang Anda miliki.

segments.src: 2. **Capture the employer match first.** Free matching dollars generally come before any other savings goal.
segments.tr: **2. Tangkap kecocokan pemberi kerja terlebih dahulu.** Dolar pencocokan gratis umumnya didahulukan dari tujuan tabungan lainnya.

segments.src: 3. **Ask about plan features.** Find out whether your plan offers Roth contributions, catch-up contributions, and the ages 60 to 63 option.
segments.tr: 3. **Tanyakan tentang fitur rencana.** Cari tahu apakah rencana Anda menawarkan kontribusi Roth, kontribusi catch-up, dan opsi usia 60 hingga 63.

segments.src: 4. **Plan for the Roth catch-up rule** if your wages are near the threshold.
segments.tr: 4. **Rencanakan aturan catch-up Roth** jika upah Anda mendekati ambang batas.

segments.src: 5. **Set up automatic increases.** Many plans can raise your contribution rate annually, which makes use of new room without extra effort.
segments.tr: 5. **Siapkan kenaikan otomatis.** Banyak rencana dapat menaikkan tingkat kontribusi Anda setiap tahun, yang memanfaatkan ruang baru tanpa usaha ekstra.

segments.src: 6. **Review your tax situation.** A tax professional can help you decide between pre-tax and Roth contributions based on your current and expected future bracket.
segments.tr: 6. **Tinjau situasi pajak Anda.** Seorang profesional pajak dapat membantu Anda memilih antara kontribusi pra-pajak dan Roth berdasarkan kisaran pajak Anda saat ini dan yang diharapkan di masa depan.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: The yearly adjustment is a small but useful opportunity.
segments.tr: Penyesuaian tahunan adalah peluang kecil namun berguna.

segments.src: Whether the new limits matter to you depends less on the headline numbers and more on your income, your age, and what your plan allows.
segments.tr: Apakah batas baru itu penting bagi Anda tidak terlalu bergantung pada angka utama dan lebih bergantung pada pendapatan Anda, usia Anda, dan apa yang diizinkan oleh rencana Anda.

segments.src: Once the IRS publishes the official 2027 figures, compare them with your current contribution settings and adjust early in the year, when you have the most time to spread contributions across paychecks.
segments.tr: Setelah IRS menerbitkan angka resmi 2027, bandingkan dengan pengaturan kontribusi Anda saat ini dan sesuaikan di awal tahun, saat Anda memiliki paling banyak waktu untuk menyebarkan kontribusi di seluruh gaji.
